Name: Auto-change Outfits
Author: ahomiepassingby
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][color=#F08787][size=4]Tired of always having to adjust your outfits manually to match the vibe?[/size][/color][/font]
[b][size=5][font=Georgia]This mod can help! [/font]✨[/size][/b][/center]


[font=Georgia]A [s]very simple[/s] mod that allows you to [b][i]auto-change your clothes [/i][/b]when the time comes, using your custom saved outfits from the [i]Hand Mirror[/i] (FS). [b]Works in multiplayer[/b] as long as all of you have the same clothing mods to see each other's outfits.[/font]

[quote][font=Georgia][b]First,[/b] you need to set up your clothes and save them. Use the following names when saving:
[b][i]*Regular Outfits:[/i] [/b]
- [i]Daily+[number]:[/i] Your daily outfit. (e.g., Daily1, Daily2,...)
- [i]Spring+[number]:[/i] Your spring outfit. (e.g., Spring1, Spring2,...)
- [i]Summer+[number]: [/i]Your summer outfit. (e.g., Summer1, Summer2,...)
-[i] Fall+[number]:[/i] Your fall outfit. (e.g., Fall1, Fall2,...)

[b][i]*Winter Outfits:[/i][/b]
- [i]Winter+[number]:[/i] Your winter outfit. (e.g., Winter1, Winter2,...)
- [i]Windoors+[number]: [/i]Your indoor winter outfit. (e.g., Windoors1, Windoors2,...)
- [i]Snowwear+[number]:[/i] Your snow-day outfit. (e.g., Snowwear1, Snowwear2,...)
-[i] Snindoors+[number]: [/i]Your indoor snow-day outfit. (e.g., Snindoors1, Snindoors2,...)

[b][i]*Rainwears: [/i][/b]
- [i]Raincoat+[number]:[/i] Your rainy-day outfit. (e.g., Raincoat1, Raincoat2,...)
- [i]Rindoors+[number]:[/i] Your indoor rainy-day outfit. (e.g., Rindoors1, Rindoors2,...)
- [i]Rspring+[number]:[/i] Your spring rainy-day outfit. (e.g., Rspring1, Rspring2,...)
- [i]Rinspring+[number]:[/i] Your indoor spring rainy-day outfit. (e.g., Rinspring1, Rinspring2,...)
- [i]Rsummer+[number]: [/i]Your summer rainy-day outfit. (e.g., Rsummer1, Rsummer2,...)
- [i]Rinsummer+[number]:[/i] Your indoor summer rainy-day outfit. (e.g., Rinsummer1, Rinsummer2,...)
- [i]Rfall+[number]: [/i]Your fall rainy-day outfit. (e.g., Rfall1, Rfall2,...)
- [i]Rinfall+[number]: [/i]Your indoor fall rainy-day outfit. (e.g., Rinfall1, Rinfall2,...)
- [i]Rwinter+[number]: [/i]Your winter rainy-day outfit. (e.g., Rwinter1, Rwinter2,...)
- [i]Rinwinter+[number]: [/i]Your indoor winter rainy-day outfit. (e.g., Rinwinter1, Rinwinter2,...)

[b][i]*Pyjamas:[/i][/b]
- [i]Pyjama+[number]: [/i]Your home pyjama. (e.g., Pyjama1, Pyjama2,...)
- [i]Pyspring+[number]: [/i]Your spring home pyjama. (e.g., Pyspring1, Pyspring2,...)
- [i]Pysummer+[number]:[/i] Your summer home pyjama. (e.g., Pysummer1, Pysummer2,...)
- [i]Pyfall+[number]: [/i]Your fall home pyjama. (e.g., Pyfall1, Pyfall2,...)
- [i]Pywinter+[number]: [/i]Your winter home pyjama. (e.g., Pywinter1, Pywinter2,...)

[i][b]*Farm workwears:[/b] [/i]
- [i]Farm+[number]: [/i]Your farm working outfit. (e.g., Farm1, Farm2,...)
- [i]Fspring+[number]: [/i]Your spring farm working outfit. (e.g., Fspring1, Fspring2,...)
- [i]Fsummer+[number]: [/i]Your summer farm working outfit. (e.g., Fsummer1, Fsummer2,...)
- [i]Ffall+[number]:[/i] Your fall farm working outfit. (e.g., Ffall1, Ffall2,...)
- [i]Fwinter+[number]:[/i] Your winter farm working outfit. (e.g., Fwinter1, Fwinter2,...)

[b][i]*Beachwears: [/i][/b]
- [i]Beach+[number]:[/i] Your beach outfit. (e.g., Beach1, Beach2,...)
- [i]Bspring+[number]:[/i] Your spring beach outfit. (e.g., Bspring1, Bspring2,...)
- [i]Bsummer+[number]:[/i] Your summer beach outfit. (e.g., Bsummer1, Bsummer2,...)
- [i]Bfall+[number]:[/i] Your fall beach outfit. (e.g., Bfall1, Bfall2,...)
- [i]Bwinter+[number]:[/i] Your winter beach outfit. (e.g., Bwinter1, Bwinter2,...)
-[i] Island+[number]: [/i]Your Ginger Island outfit. (e.g., Island1, Island2,...)

[b][i]*Spa: [/i][/b]
- [i]Spa+[number]:[/i] Your outfit when entering the bathhouse at Spa. (e.g., Spa1, Spa2,...)

[i][b]*Cave Gears: [/b][/i]
- [i]Cave+[number]:[/i] Your outfit when entering caves. (e.g., Cave1, Cave2,...)
- [i]Cspring+[number]:[/i] Your spring outfit when entering caves. (e.g., Cspring1, Cspring2,...)
- [i]Csummer+[number]: [/i]Your summer outfit when entering caves. (e.g., Csummer1, Csummer2,...)
- [i]Cfall+[number]:[/i] Your fall outfit when entering caves. (e.g., Cfall1, Cfall2,...)
- [i]Cwinter+[number]:[/i] Your winter outfit when entering caves. (e.g., Cwinter1, Cwinter2,...)

[b][i]*Festivals:[/i][/b]
- [i]Egg: [/i]Your outfit for The Egg Festival.
- [i]Flowerdance: [/i]Your outfit for The Flower Dance.
- [i]Luau: [/i]Your outfit for The Luau.
- [i]Jellies:[/i] Your outfit for The Dance of the Moonlight Jellies.
- [i]SVfair: [/i]Your outfit for The Stardew Valley Fair.
- [i]Halloween: [/i]Your outfit for The Spirit's Eve.
- [i]Icefes: [/i]Your outfit for The Festival of Ice.
- [i]Xmas:[/i] Your outfit for The Feast of the Winter Star.

[b][i]*Supported other mods: [/i][/b]
[b][i]  **Polyamory Sweet / Free Love:**[/i][/b]
- [i]Wedding+[number]:[/i] Your wedding dress/suit. (e.g., Wedding1, Wedding2,...)
- [i]Wedding_{{spouse}}: [/i]Name after your spouse. (e.g., Wedding_Sebastian)

[b][i]  **Happy Birthday:**[/i][/b]
- [i]Birthday: [/i]Your birthday outfit.

 [b][i] **Weather Wonders:**[/i][/b]
- [i]Umbrella+[number]: [/i]Outfit for dangerous weather - hailstorm, acid rain. (e.g., Umbrella1, Umbrella2,...)
- [i]Fold+[number]:[/i] Fold your umbrella before getting indoors. (e.g., Fold1, Fold2,...)
- [i]Sand+[number]: [/i]Outfit for Sandstorm on Desert (WW beta). (e.g., Sand1, Sand2,...)

When you have [u]more than 1 outfit[/u] and want it to change randomly day by day, open the config (mod options), enable exactly the outfits you want to randomize, and set the quantity you have. Then, name your outfits in sequence.

[b]Second[/b] thing you should do is head to the mod options, because I set almost config to `false`. You should open it and set as you want.[/font][/quote]
[font=Georgia][b][size=4]Currently Implemented Changes:[/size][/b][/font]
[quote][font=Georgia]- Wear [b][i]pyjamas[/i][/b] at the farmhouse during bedtime (10 p.m. - 7 a.m.) or all day if it rains or snows.
- Bundle up for [b][i]rainy [/i][/b]or [i][b]snowy [/b][/i][b][i]days [/i][/b]when you go out.
- For winter, rain, or snow, switch to an [b][i]indoor-friendly version[/i][/b] when you're inside (like taking off the raincoat).
- Put on specific clothes when doing [b][i]chores on your farm[/i][/b].
- Dress for the [b][i]beach [/i][/b]or set up unique outfits for your [b][i]Ginger Island[/i][/b] vacation.
- If you opt for [b][i]seasonal outfits[/i][/b], taking a trip to the Calico Desert will automatically switch you into your [i][b]summer outfits[/b][/i] without needing any extra setup.
- Switch your clothes before heading into the [b][i]caves [/i][/b]to keep them clean.
- Wear a special outfit when entering the [b][i]spa [/i][/b](requires custom Fashion Sense swimsuit settings).
- Put on a unique outfit to shine bright at [b][i]festivals[/i][/b].
- Set your [b][i]wedding dress or suit[/i][/b], with support for multiple outfits if using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]FreeLove[/url].
- Celebrate in a special [b][i]birthday [/i][/b]outfit (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url] mod), which stays indoors if it's raining or snowing.
- Match your wardrobe with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868]Weather Wonders[/url] mod, including [b][i]gear for dangerous weather[/i][/b].
- Because your [i][b]wedding[/b] [/i]is your most special day, your outfit will hardly change at all except when entering the caves. Similarly, [b][i]festivals and birthdays[/i][/b] are highly prioritized, meaning your outfit won't change as long as you are out and about in the Valley![/font][/quote]
[font=Georgia][size=4][b]Regarding the swimsuit at the Spa:[/b] [/size]Due to Fashion Sense mechanics, entering the pool forces the game to use the vanilla swimsuit, meaning only your hair and accessories will actually change. To fully use a custom Fashion Sense swimsuit, the creator of that clothes pack must set `[/font][i][font=Georgia]"HideWhileWearingBathingSuit": false`[/font][/i][font=Georgia] in their code. (Or, you can go right into their file and add the line yourself!)[/font]

[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/htX5tt1d/image.png[/img][/font]

[size=4][font=Georgia][b]A quick guide to adding this line:[/b][/font][/size]
[font=Georgia][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38381/38381-1792233023-1407763059.png[/img][/font]
[font=Georgia]Locate the clothing folders (you only need to focus on these 2!). Inside, you'll see 4 main directional fields: Front, Back, Left, and Right (e.g., "FrontShirt", "FrontPant", etc.). You just need to add the line `[i]"HideWhileWearingBathingSuit": false`[/i] under all 4 of these fields. That's all!
[b]Plus: [/b]If you want your top shirt to [b]stay visible[/b] while you are actually [b]in the water[/b], you also need to add the line `[i]"HideWhileSwimming": false`[/i] (you can do this for the pants too, if you want).[/font]


[font=Georgia][size=4][b]For now,[/b] [/size]I only use [b]SVE [/b]as an expansion mod, so this mod [color=#08CB00]is compatible[/color] with it. But it doesn't mean that my mod is incompatible with others; it's just that when you reach certain conditions in those maps, the outfits may not change. If you want any other expansion mod to be compatible as well, you can suggest it to me, and I will consider it.[/font]


[font=Georgia][b][size=4]Translations: [/size][/b]Feel free to translate this mod into any language — no need to ask for permission. Just make sure to credit the original mod and link to this page. I really appreciate your effort in helping more players enjoy this mod.[/font]
